section.title: Introduction and Overview
section.p: The EvaluateExpression module provides the SWI . This call attempts to calculate the value of the string passed to it. Although the SWI itself is not normally used by the programmer, its effects are seen most commonly through the *SetEval and *If commands.

subsection.title: Operators
subsection.p: OS_EvaluateExpression is defined to operate using a number of specified operations. These are unchanged since RISC OS 2 (and possibly earlier). Dependent on their context, the operations are applied to either numbers or strings, with the preference being for string operations.

Obtain the leftmost characters from a string

subsection.p: In addition, the EvaluateExpression module also provides a number of extensions to these operators :

subsubsection.title: LEAFNAME
subsubsection.p: Return the leaf name from the path specified.

subsubsection.title: DIRNAME
subsubsection.p: Return the directory name from the path specified.

subsubsection.title: CANONICALISE
subsubsection.p: Convert the path specified to its canonical form.

subsubsection.title: TIMEFORMAT
subsubsection.p: Format the current time in the format specified.

subsubsection.title: SET
subsubsection.p: Returns boolean value of whether a system variable is set, -1 if set, 0 if not set.

subsubsection.title: MODULEVERSION
subsubsection.p: Returns the version number of a module multiplied by 100 or -1 if not present.
